notes.title: Kingdom of Cards 1.0 Update is Live!
notes.content:
Hello, Kingdom builders!

 

The exciting moment has finally arrived—Kingdom of Cards 1.0 is officially out now!🎉

We want to thank all the players who supported us during Early Access. Your feedback has helped shape the game into what it is today.

 

This 1.0 update brings the ultimate challenge, new ways to shape your kingdom, and a wealth of fresh content. Here’s what’s new:

 

In-run Save System: Pause and resume your adventure anytime—no more worrying about losing progress.

The Final Boss: Face the toughest, most epic showdown at the end of your journey.

Boss Rush Mode: Unlocked after defeating the Final Boss, this new challenge will push your skills and strategy to the limit.

Reworked Kingdom Upgrade Flow: Early building choices are now more randomized, making your starting decisions even more impactful.

10 New Perks: Expand your tactical options and build unique playstyles.

Perk Slots Expanded: Equip up to 3 perks at once for deeper combinations.

New Building: Recruitment Camp — Offer up to three loot cards to recruit a random unit. The higher their combined gold value, the better the unit you'll receive. Choose wisely, and may luck be on your side!

Golden Packs: Buildings now have a chance to reward rare packs that contain more powerful cards.

New Cards & Combinations: Discover fresh synergies and strategies.

New Enemies: Take on tougher and more diverse opponents.

New Achievements: Celebrate your milestones with new rewards.

Overall Improvements & Bug Fixes: A smoother and more polished gameplay experience.
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"]Whether you’re stepping into the kingdom for the first time or you’ve been with us since the Early Access days, this update offers brand-new strategic depth and exciting challenges for everyone.
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"]And here’s a little teaser: on October 9, we’ll be launching a special bundle with Kingdom Rush 5. We hope you’ll enjoy this surprise collaboration!

notes.title: Update Log V0.3 — The Kingdom Evolves
notes.content:
Kingdom of Cards Featured at Latin American Games Showcase as part of Summer Game Fest with a New Trailer and Update Announcement!🎉🎉



What’s new in this update:


Boss-Dependent Map Visuals
Each boss now leaves their mark on the kingdom — buildings will visually shift depending on who you’re facing, adding flavor and clarity to each run.


Improved Combinations
The recipe system has been refined! You’ll now encounter fewer failed results when combining cards, making experimentation more rewarding.


Custom Land Selection
You’re in control: pick which lands to include in your run instead of relying on random choices. Plan ahead and shape your strategy from the start.


New Card Type: Loot
A new category for sellable treasures. Loot cards now stand apart from crafting materials.


New Card Added to the Shop: Ezrick's Tavern
A new location card has appeared in the shop. Explore it to uncover a new kind of reward.

notes.title: Update Log V0.2.0 - Enchantments Awaits!
notes.content:
Hello Kingdom Builders,

In this update, we’re thrilled to introduce Enchanter’s Spires and a brand-new card type: Enchantments. Unleash your creativity by combining powerful ingredients and uncover hidden surprises. Alongside these major additions, we’ve enhanced the reward system, polished the UI, fine-tuned the game balance, and addressed several bugs to bring you an even smoother experience. Dive back in and see what enchantments await you!

- New Building: Enchanter’s Spires
Channel enchantment cards and test your knowledge — combine the right ingredients to earn powerful rewards… or suffer the consequences.

- New Card Type: Enchantments
Discover and experiment with mystical combinations to unlock new effects and surprises.

- Reward System Updates

 Exploring now focuses on discovering new cards.
 Stealing offers valuable items for selling or rare special cards.

- UI Improvements
Visual upgrades across the interface for a smoother experience.

- Balance Updates
Tweaks to pacing and mechanics for a better gameplay flow.

- Bug Fixes

 Locked unit cards can no longer be removed from battle.
 Fixed an issue where shop units sometimes showed 0 attack.
 Other minor fixes and stability improvements.

notes.title: Patch Note V0.1.4
notes.content:
Hello Kingdom Builders,

Since launch, your incredible support and feedback have helped shape this card-built kingdom. Today’s update brings bug fixes, pacing improvements, and balance adjustments to enhance your experience. Check out the details below!

[Balance and Pacing Improvements]

 Adjusted invasions enemies and difficulty, especially in the first run.
 Updated conquer, exploration, and stealing rewards for various locations and invasions.
 Increased the number of location cards rewarded during runs.
 Lands no longer tap.

[Bug Fixes]

 Fixed the issue where the blood moon never ends in certain situations.
 Fixed a bug that prevented some achievements from being granted.
 Other minor fixes.

🎉 Thank You for Playing! 🎉

We’re just getting started—keep sharing your thoughts in the Steam Community Hub and on our Discord!

notes.title: Demo is now updated with new features and contents!
notes.content:
Hello Kingdom Buildier,

The free demo of Kingdom of Cards has been updated and is now featured in the Steam February Next Fest! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3367090

Key updates include:

 Planning Menu——A new hub where you can check boss info, review your unlocked cards in the album, and buy new cards that may appear in future sessions.
 XP Shop——Use your XP to unlock new cards that might show up in your next run!
 More Cards & Combinations——New cards to combine them for unique results!
 Better Balance——Adjustments to make the game more fun and rewarding.
 Polish & Improvements——Various tweaks, fixes, and refinements to improve the overall experience.


Meanwhile, we’re still polishing the game. And we’re almost ready to announce the release date—stay tuned!

notes.title: Kingdom of Cards Demo Now Available! 🃏✨
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The wait is over! We're thrilled to announce that Kingdom of Cards Demo is officially live on Steam. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3367090/_/

What’s included in the demo: 

 Over 50 unique cards to discover
 7 unlockable facilities to craft and enhance your deck
 5+ areas to explore, conquer, or plunder
 15+ enemy types to challenge your strategy
 A challenging boss fight that will test your skills


Your Feedback Matters!

As this is a demo version, your thoughts and suggestions are invaluable to us. Join our community on Discord to share your feedback, report bugs, and discuss strategies with fellow players!

Thank you for your support, and let’s make this kingdom flourish together!
